change_summary: Truncate long past tool-response messages when building the prompt to stop them inflating context.
reason_for_change: Each task averages ~10 tool calls whose 1–3 KB JSON payloads stay in the dialogue forever, dominating prompt tokens and driving the ≈$0.04 mean cost. Once the assistant has processed a tool result, the raw blob is rarely reused verbatim. Replacing any tool message >300 chars with its first 200 chars plus “…[truncated]” keeps status/IDs visible but removes hundreds of tokens from every later turn, cutting context size by ~20-25 % while leaving reasoning intact.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — invalid run: 12 task(s) crashed in the harness (harness_error) — the change breaks the harness
hypothesis: Very long tool-response messages (full order & product JSON) inflate context; replacing their content with a short placeholder after they have been seen will cut token load without harming reasoning (the assistant already parsed the data when it arrived).
